sourceQuote: Graduates can engage in teaching, research and research in education, science and technology, economics and other departments, or engage in practical application, development, research and management in production, operation and management departments.
targetQuote: 毕业生可在中小学从事教育教学与教育研究工作，也可在科技、经济等部门从事教学、研究与研究工作，或在生产、经营和管理部门从事实践应用、开发、研究与管理工作。
